subject: AI Video Surveillance - Coffee
text:
Hi [NAME],

Heard great things about your work at UncannyVision / EEN from Tijmen Vos
and Hari Surendranath at ISC West. Wanted to reach out since we work with
Flock Safety, Milestone Systems, Rhombus Systems and LiveView Technologies
on similar computer vision models for physical security. Thought it might
be a good time to connect.

For context.. We help over 200 AI teams accelerate their model development
by consolidating large-scale video data curation, annotation, workflow
automation and model eval in one platform.

Given your extensive experience in managing AI video surveillance products,
I'd love to get your candid feedback on what we've built. Let me know if
you're open for a quick chat Tuesday to Friday next week?

subject: Plan for CVPR
text:

We are also hosting an AI/ML happy hour on Friday - you'd be more than welcome to join & share with whoever - let me know if you'd like more info on this & I can share the link.

subject: lip syncing - working w/ flawless, synthesia and captions
text:
Hi [NAME],

I saw you're hiring MLEs and Research Scientists for generative models and
face tracking so I thought to reach out. We work with Flawless, Synthesia
and Captions to develop their computer vision models for very similar use
cases: lip syncing and video generation. Thought it might be a good time to
chat!

For context - We're a computer vision data development platform of choice
for over 200 AI teams. We've tailored our workflow for generative AI teams
with video-native data curation & annotation and advanced face-tracking
annotation capabilities.

Curious how you're thinking about developing your CV features, and happy to
share our perspectives from working within the space. Let me know if you're
open to a quick chat Tuesday to Friday next week?
